sentences.text: MR BN LIMBACHIA(3454) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 MR MITESH AMIN, PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 =================================

=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE R.P.DHOLARIA  Date : 23/08/2018  ORAL ORDER Order in Criminal Revision Application No. 990 of 2018 Rule.
Mr. Mitesh Amin, learned Public Prosecutor waives service of notice of rule on behalf of respondent-State.

Heard learned advocate Mr. B.N. Limbachia for the applicant and learned Public Prosecutor Mr.
Mitesh Amin for the respondent - State.

As such, on going through the records, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused is under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 which is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty prescribed for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Section 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

In view of the above, this revision application stands allowed and order of conviction recorded by both the Courts below stands quashed and the original accused is directed to pay a fine of Rs. 25,000/- in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within a period of fifteen days and it shall in turn transmit the said amount to Ahmedabad Khemaraj Laljibhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 23 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154480025/
1 Municipal Corporation.
